target_customer: Students, academics and research-led companies (consumer and B2B subscriptions).
problem: Researchers struggle to find, understand and write scientific documents across hundreds of millions of papers and their own files.
business_model: Freemium subscription with team and API products

founders.name: Naveed Janmohamed
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as the only founder; no background or education given.

technical_complexity.rationale: Citation grounded retrieval over a large paper corpus, PDF parsing and writing tools is demanding LLM engineering, but built on third party models.

defensibility.rationale: Many similar tools exist; the company's differentiator is distribution through social content (600M+ views claimed) and a large user base, not technology.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Competitor comparison pages exist but no incumbent copying or acquisition was found; Anara reported Anara 3.0 on 2026-04-23.

market_need_then: The YC page claims 3M users across hundreds of colleges and research companies and approaching $10M in yearly revenue, all company claims.

branding.domain_note: Uses anara.com, the exact name plus .com after the rebrand; the earlier name used unriddle.ai.

identity.voice_and_tone: Scientific instrument framing in the Anara 3.0 announcement

branding.brand_signature: Short form social video content claimed to reach 600M+ people

rebrands.why: Not stated in sources; the date is per aggregator summaries and the March 2025 ANARA trademark filing

branding.community_and_virality: Company claims 600M+ views across Instagram, TikTok and YouTube and 3M users; self-reported.

brand_strength.rationale: Self-reported social reach and user count suggest real awareness, but only company sources were opened and the rebrand name has no independent press.

outcome_analysis: Anara grew quickly through short social video distribution, reporting 3M users and nearing $10M in annual revenue according to its YC page, then rebranded from Unriddle in March 2025 and shipped Anara 3.0 in April 2026. The funding picture is thin and aggregator figures conflict, and the space is crowded, so the strength rests on distribution rather than a technical lead.
notes: The $3M round is stated on the YC page without a stage or date, so stage is other. Aggregators report $2.2M to $3M total, a pre-seed of $500K under the Unriddle name, investors Pioneer Fund, Transpose Platform and Preston-Werner Ventures, and one claims a March 2026 $70M post-money after $13M raised; the last is uncorroborated and not recorded. Search listed competitors only in 2025 or 2026 comparison blogs, so none are recorded as of founding.
